newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks up in sluggish Easter week trade.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks up in sluggish Easter week trade.

text.p: Colombian stocks edged up slightly Tuesday on sluggish Easter week trading.
Bogota's IBB index gained 0.27 percent to 1,068.07 on volume of 465 million pesos, while Medellin's IBOMED general price index ended up 0.11 percent at 16,557.11 on 254 million pesos.

"Today's trading was minimal. I would have thought we would have seem some cross deals today, but not even they materialized," a Bogota broker said. One of the biggest gains was cigarrette maker Coltabaco, up 1.51 percent at 3,350 in Bogota, but unchanged in Medellin.
Banco de Colombia gained 0.47 percent to 426 in Bogota, but was not traded in Medellin.
Banco Ganadero ordinary shares was up 0.29 percent to 341 in Bogota and up 0.32 percent to 340.1 in Medellin.
Brewer Bavaria, which last Thursday announced the possibility of a share split to facilitate the division of the company, was up 0.73 percent to 6,850 in Bogota.
